text.p: MDU Resources Group Inc said Thursday it has named Martin White president and chief executive.
Most recently, he was senior vice president of corporate development at the company. The appointment is effective on April 1, 1998, on the retirement of H.J. Mellen.
Mellen had announced his plan to retire earlier this year.

MDU is a natural resource company comprised of construction materials and mining operations, oil and natural gas acquisition, exploration and production activities, an electric and natural gas utility with related construction services, and a natural gas transmission company.
